items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The front line was myself, Hot Lips Page and Don Byas and a French rhythm section.

ctx.x: So when you played there, what groups did you play in, what settings actually did you play in?

At the Festival of Jazz, the producers put me in with Hot Lips Page. The front line was myself, Hot Lips Page and Don Byas and a French rhythm section. I think the piano player, he was pretty famous in France. His name is Bernard Peiffer.
